functions.doc: Convert one yuv420 frame to rgb8 and publish it with the given stamp.
functions.doc_full: Convert one yuv420 frame to rgb8 and publish it with the given stamp. This runs in a daemon thread, so an uncaught exception (a malformed frame, a shape mismatch) would silently kill only this thread: no exception reaches rclpy.spin(), no process exits for systemd to notice, and the node would look healthy while never publishing again. Catch and skip the frame instead.

pitfusion3d_bringup/scripts/clean_stale_.doc:
Remove Fast DDS shared-memory files in /dev/shm that no running process
has mapped/open. Fast DDS only deletes its segments on a clean exit, so a
crash / kill -9 / OOM leaves one segment per participant behind; with the
64MB segments used here that is ~0.5GB of RAM per unclean shutdown.
Only touches this user's fastrtps files and never a file a live process
uses (so it is safe even if another ROS tool is running).
Usage: clean_stale_shm.py [--dry-run]
